analysis.failure_policy: Runtime failures remain explicit. Full-denominator pair accuracy counts unscored pairs as incorrect; conditional pair accuracy reports its denominator. Empty detector masks retain the fixed all-pairs zero policy; exclude is a sensitivity analysis.
metrics: test pairwise accuracy with zero tie margin
test pairwise accuracy with method-specific margin calibrated on dev only
mask-present fraction and multiple-instance frame counts
analysis.split: Keep existing source-prompt dev/test split. Separately report test prompts not among known_masked_development_prompts; all results remain retained.
analysis.tie_margin: Among 0 and observed dev absolute score gaps, maximize dev exact ternary-label accuracy; break ties with smallest margin. Test never calibrates margin.

box_detector.selection: All target-class instances; no largest/highest-only selection or tracking. Every frame is newly detected.

claim_limit: Automatic object-class masks are not human contour truth; natural accuracy and background robustness are different tests. No excellent-repair claim solely from raw score level or two blur examples.
cohort: All 1440 exact official Subject Consistency videos; 72 prompts x 4 generators x 5 seeds; no score, image-quality or detection filtering.
determinism: DINO and MobileSAM run strict deterministic inference. Box forward temporarily permits native CUDA ROIAlign; record settings and run a mask replay smoke. No external checkpoint modification or downloads.
known_masked_development_prompts: a boat accelerating to gain speed
a person drinking coffee in a cafe
a person giving a presentation to a room full of colleagues
an airplane landing smoothly on a runway
an airplane soaring through a clear blue sky
segmentation: Pinned MobileSAM vit_t, each per-frame automatic box, multimask false, union all target instances. Misses stay empty; no clean-mask substitution or construction masks. This is a separate automatic protocol, not a human-confirmed run.
